environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with a single shared database role (app_service_role) that has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on all tenant tables. No RLS policies are defined on the customers table. CloudWatch Logs captures all console.log output including formatted strings. The Lambda response includes the log_ref field which returns the formatted log message directly to the caller, enabling format string information disclosure.
